Resolves #21584

On desktop, a small example card now shows two lines of its proof instead of one, and the scrim behind the text is opaque. All 12 Start here captions read whole at 1440 × 900, where 6 were cut, and at 1366, 1280 and 844 px, where 4 were cut at each size. Every cover stays at least 47.3 % clear against a 45 % guard. The phone keeps one resting line, because a tap opens the card. Both changes return to decided design: #21119's ledger cuts a proof line only past two lines, and #20724 chose an opaque text region.

Evidence: L3 (local e2e on the Portal, red on `dev` and green at head, with before and after frames) → L3 required (all five ACs are rendered behaviour). Residual: none.

## Deltas from ticket

- The Fix said the scrim token "becomes the opaque surface". The token is removed instead: the gradient and the multi-window chip read `--portal-examples-list-surface`, so one colour no longer has two names.
- The compact rule's clamp line is deleted rather than set to 2, because the base rule already clamps at two lines.

The 4 phone tests fail "the caption paints its surface behind the text, not the cover" | not run |
| head | 8 passed | 26 passed |

Before the fix, Table Filtering's caption padding painted (25, 27, 30) over its white cover, where the surface is (13, 15, 18): 5 % of the cover came through. At head, all 12 Start here captions read whole. On the group pages, the six captions longer than two lines (117 to 133 characters) stay cut, as the ticket expected.

Frame critique:
- In a row, a two-line caption now starts higher than a one-line neighbour, so the titles no longer share a line. Kept: the caption docks to the card's foot, and #21119 allows two lines.
- The 22 px fade above the badge still shows the cover, for example Table Filtering's header row. Kept: it is #20724's glass lip, and the text region below it is opaque.
- On the phone, the resting caption still ends in an ellipsis (Workstation). Kept: a tap opens the card.
- Visible but outside this ticket, from the gate read: the large "Running the production build" control (finding 3), the phone's chrome before the first card (5), and the phone header without GitHub and Discord (9).
